notes: Sheet is north-up. Names: OHIO AV., GRAHAM, ELYSIAN (NOT OPEN), CLIFF (NOT OPEN), VAN LEAR ALLEY, LEWIS ALLEY, VINE, MULBERRY, ST. JOE, PRIVATE ROAD; suffix-less names written with 'Street'. Elysian is written 'Elyisian Street' to match sheet 244, which spells it ELYISIAN; this sheet prints ELYSIAN (correct spelling), so 244 and 232 should probably both be 'Elysian Street'. St. Joe Street spelled as on sheet 170. Ohio/Clifton is not on this sheet (the centreline crossing is below the bottom edge; it is on 219). Graham/Cliff is not picked: its centre falls at or above the top edge of the paper (it is on 244). The 50 ft street from Cliff's bend SW to Ohio, with steps along both sides (house nos. 2100-2129), carries no separate name; it is drawn continuous with Cliff (NOT OPEN) and is recorded as Cliff Street (uncertain; it might be a separately named street or steps). Elysian below its bend is an irregular open way between lots, reaching the Cliff diagonal; the Private Road (13' at its mouth, along a 10 ft retaining wall) runs from Ohio at Ohio's bend east to Elysian. Van Lear Alley (printed VAN LEAR ALLEY) runs from Ohio at Ohio's lower bend NE then NNE to a dead end; it is not the same piece as 244's Van Lear Street (which ends at a lot line on 244). A hatched stairway marked UP/STEPS runs ESE from Van Lear Alley toward Vine (not recorded). Vine's east side is the Volume 2 area ('SEE VOLUME TWO'); St. Joe and Mulberry leave it to the east (T). Mulberry's mouth is flared (north line slope ~1.0, south line ~0.64); the point is on Vine's centre at Mulberry's mid-mouth line, ~65 px north of the pipe junction (Mulberry is 70 ft on sheet 170; +-40 px uncertain). Lewis Alley/Ohio and Lewis Alley/Vine are also on 219. The unnamed 15 ft alley (printed ALLEY, 15' at both ends) runs from the hillside lot line ESE to Ohio (alleys). Pipes, lot lines and hillside lettering ignored.
